title: Something's eating the CPU
briefing: The fans are screaming. One process is burning cycles it never earned.
tips: `ps aux` lists every process with its CPU%. `top` sorts by CPU for you.
objective: Find the process using the most CPU and write its PID into ~/hog.txt.
hints: List what's running and look at the %CPU column — one will dwarf the rest.
`ps aux` or `top` shows it. Note the PID (the number in the PID column).
explanation: Every running program is a process with a PID (process id), an owner and a resource footprint. `ps aux` lists them all; `top` sorts by CPU so the greedy one rises to the top. The PID is the handle you use to control it.
